claims.explanation: BMS-345541 is a selective allosteric inhibitor of IKK1/IKK2 (CHUK/IKBKB) that blocks NF-kB-dependent transcription. Cancer lines with constitutive or high NF-kB pathway activity, often driven by upstream mutations such as KRAS, BRAF, or NF1, are expected to be more dependent on IKK/NF-kB signaling and thus more sensitive to the drug, while lines with low NF-kB activity or intact negative regulators are less affected.
